Pilot: contractor (from: contractor). Movers run like a project: a survey of the goods first, a written estimate, a signed estimate with a deposit, then the move. That is the contractor's estimate visit, quote, contract and deposit, then the work.
Flow B main path visit|none|bill: the booked visit is the in-home survey (Thu Oct 22, 8–10am, Tomás), priced at the visit and free. The picker's 'Quoted at the visit' reads 'Quoted after a survey' (money.B.labels).
The survey is free, so the master's $89 service call never applies to it. The $89 becomes Lee Moving's trip fee for list jobs (a late cancel or nobody home), which keeps the master's numbers on the list paths.
Tomás's written estimate (B8-20 words) leads into the master's 'An estimate becomes its own job', renamed '1 Signs the estimate': B8-62 (Alex signs and picks the protection, then Sam) and B8-63 (the $200 deposit; the move is booked for Sat Oct 31, crew 8–9am, delivery 2–7pm).

After the signing, the overlay's own steps run inside that branch: B8-x01 the reminder before free cancel ends (Wed 8am, 72 hours before pickup, the example's rule), B8-x02 the changes before move day (building proof and elevator, added items, a cancel with the deposit, a new date in writing, a crew chief out), B8-x13 the day-before reminder, then move day B8-x14 to B8-x21 (code at the door, walk-through, revised estimate, bill of lading, tags, weighing, a missed window).
